# OpenSonarX

> Free, open-source search engine built for AI agents and LLMs.

OpenSonarX is a search engine that returns full Markdown content with trust signals — so AI agents don't have to fetch and parse web pages. It uses 8x fewer tokens than the traditional search API + page fetching approach.

## Key facts
- Free and open source (MIT license)
- Returns full content, not just links and snippets
- 8x fewer tokens than search API + fetch (835 vs 6,448 median)
- Saves ~$17,500/month per 1M queries vs traditional approach
- Hybrid search: HNSW vector (384-dim MiniLM) + BM25 keyword
- Decentralized P2P network (libp2p)
- Works out of the box with DuckDuckGo — no API key needed
- CLI tool: `oi search "your query"`
- Retrieval rank is stake/reputation/DNS neutral; OpenUncertainty is an experimental claim-level Stage-2 layer
- Claim-specific cash at risk may affect calibrated reliance only after held-out validation; raw domain stake never buys rank or confidence

## Install
curl -fsSL https://opensonarx.com/install.sh | sh
